text:
alex: Noticed invoice-preview token duplication after client key rotation. spikes for a handful of tenants. anyone seen this pattern?

jamie: probably retries + fingerprint flip on key change. example?

alex: log snippet: ```metering_event tenant=acme req_id=rid-42 client_key=key-old->key-new retry=1 tokens=210
metering_event tenant=acme req_id=rid-42 client_key=key-new retry=2 tokens=210```

priya: Our fingerprint includes client_key today, so rotation changes dedupe identity. dedupe window is 5s, retries often later.

sasha: Short-term: increase dedupe window for cross-fingerprint matches. Long-term: rely on client-sent idempotency header.

mike: Billing prefers prevention. Fixing invoices later is painful.

alex: Proposal: require X-Client-Request-Id in SDK v2.1. For older clients, fallback to normalized prompt hash + tenant+session. Temporarily extend dedupe window to 60s when req_id matches across fingerprints.

priya: Normalization plan: trim, collapse whitespace, unicode normalize, then sha256. small collision risk but acceptable for fallback.

jamie: Implementation notes: dedupe keys must be tenant-scoped; TTL per-tenant. Add metric for dedupe_fallbacks.

mike: I'll run a 24h reconciliation job for recent invoice previews and prepare finance playbook for credits if needed.

billing-bot: metric metering.dedupe_fallbacks.count created; dashboard tile placed under Billing -> Metering.

sasha: UX: add invoice-preview warning when dedupe_fallbacks > threshold with link to SDK upgrade. I'll mock a card.

alex: Action items: jamie SDK header (3d), jamie/priya server accept+fallback (PR this week), sasha console card (mock EOD), mike reconciliation job. Canary ingest change scheduled 2026-03-24T10:00Z.

jamie: ACK, will add opt-in flag so customers can opt-in early.

alex: Re-check metrics 24h after canary. tagging @oncall for visibility.
